listing.name: Torchlight (Xbox Live Arcade) — Torchlight Recomp (YaPeL)
listing.summary: The project reports native town, dungeons, inventory and pets. Chinese and Japanese are unsupported. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Torchlight (Xbox Live Arcade) Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Download Windows/Linux/macOS Torchlight runtime and import own XBLA files; source builds also need own executable.

warnings: The project reports native town, dungeons, inventory and pets. Chinese and Japanese are unsupported.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
